source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("rail-led" OR "rail-led urbanism" OR "rail-led urbanization" OR "rail-led urbanisation" OR ("transit-oriented development" AND (urbanism OR politics OR "land value" OR "value capture" OR India OR "global south")) OR (("metro rail" OR "high-speed rail" OR "mass rapid transit") AND ("real estate" OR "land value" OR "urban development" OR "value capture")))
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("rail-led" OR "rail-led urbanism" OR "rail-led urbanization" OR "rail-led urbanisation" OR ("transit-oriented development" AND (urbanism OR politics OR "land value" OR "value capture" OR India OR "global south")) OR (("metro rail" OR "high-speed rail" OR "mass rapid transit") AND ("real estate" OR "land value" OR "urban development" OR "value capture"))),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("rail-led urbanisation" OR "rail-led urbanism" OR "rail-led urbanization" OR "rail-led" OR ("transit-oriented development" AND ("India" OR "global south" OR "land value" OR "value capture" OR "politics" OR "urbanism")) OR (("high-speed rail" OR "mass rapid transit" OR "metro rail") AND ("land value" OR "real estate" OR "urban development" OR "value capture")))
